# Seconds each top-level endpoint test adds to its shard on the real-ZFS
# VM: the time cost of a test as data (ADR 0005). ci/real-zfs-guest.sh
# shards the endpoint binary by these weights (longest first, onto the
# lightest shard); a test missing here weighs 0.1s. Only the balance
# depends on this file, never the coverage: every listed test runs in
# exactly one shard (a split test, every subtest: ci/check-split.sh), and
# ci/check-skips.sh fails a test that neither passed nor skipped.
#
# Generated by ci/real-zfs-weights.sh from the guest's test-times.tsv
# (sequential test: wall, parallel subtests included; parallel test:
# test-seconds / nproc). Do not edit by hand; rerun the script on newer
# runs when shards drift apart (shards.txt in the job summary).
# Source: run 40511369632 (806727d, job 122213851523), its -test.v shard logs from the job log through ci/test-times.awk, without timestamps. TestDestroyNeverHitsAReplacedDataset: 4.69 measured with its every-destroy sweep (18.77 test-s over 19 subtests), set by hand to 1.99 for the PR leg's first-destroy-per-case run on a real pool (its 5 destroy0 subtests: 7.96 test-s / nproc 4; crash_test.go swapSweep). Estimated by hand until the next run measures them: TestRealFacts 8.35 + 3.15 for SPC-01, SPC-02, MNT-01, MNT-02 and VOL-12 (0.75 + 0.6 + 0.6 + 0.7 + 0.5, from the 0.22-0.77 s per row of run 40513522394), TestFileExportStaleShareOnlySharenfsHeals 0.80 (a shared create, two exportfs, three cheap sets), and TestCreateVolumeCatchesDatasetReplacedBeforeCommit 0.30 (its filesystem subtest: one create, a rename, a create, three cheap calls; the block subtest is simulator-only). Wave 24's sim-only endpoint tests (own simulator, no real-pool work) are set by hand to 0.00 like the other sim-only tests: TestDeleteVolumeLockPassesAreBounded, TestDeleteVolumeSettleWindow, TestExpandRollbackFailureIsReported, TestFileExportCreateChangedBeforeCommit, TestFileExportCreateRootFailureIsRetryable, TestFileExportCreateServedBeyondByAncestor, TestFileExportRefusedPublishRestoresLocalList, TestReconcileCancelledMidRunStops, TestReconcileDefaultMaxDeletionsWithDigest, TestReconcileRescanFailureDestroysNothing, TestRootErrMapping, TestWholeScanSlotWaitEndsWithTheContext.
